focus.zh: 截至 11 月 4 日晚間的台灣及東南亞半導體、工業自動化、伺服器與電力供應鏈
focus.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asian semiconductors, automation, servers and power through the evening of Nov 4

throughline.zh: 台灣設備與工業電腦廠公布控制軟體整合及新訂單，馬來西亞銅箔與越南網路連接器子公司同日公告增資，反映不同階段的設備、訂單與資金資訊。
throughline.en: Taiwanese industrial-computing and equipment firms reported backlog and control-software integration, while copper-foil and connector makers disclosed Malaysian and Vietnamese funding, separating orders, transactions and capital plans.

title.zh: 研華 11 月 4 日法說稱在手訂單接近 25 億美元，公布工業電腦產能布局
title.en: Advantech reports nearly US$2.5B order backlog at November 4 briefing

summary.zh: 研華 11 月 4 日舉行線上法說，據中央社與 TVBS 報導，公司稱累計至 2027 年的在手訂單接近 25 億美元，第三季接單出貨比為 1.64。公司另提出台灣華亞園區、日本北九州及中國昆山廠擴建規劃，相關未來投產日期與成長率均屬預期。
summary.en: Advantech held an online investor briefing on November 4. CNA and TVBS reported a near-US$2.5 billion order backlog extending into 2027 and a third-quarter book-to-bill ratio of 1.64. The company also outlined planned expansion in Taiwan, Kitakyushu and Kunshan, with commissioning dates and growth outlooks still projections.

text.zh: 研華供應工業電腦、嵌入式運算與工廠自動化設備，應用涵蓋半導體設備、醫療與邊緣 AI。公司指出，台灣與昆山產線利用率均超過 100% 的數值係公司口徑，未附逐廠產能定義。
text.en: Advantech provides industrial PCs, embedded computing and automation systems used in semiconductor equipment, healthcare and edge AI. The company reportedly said utilization at its Taiwan and Kunshan sites exceeded 100% under its own capacity definition, without site-level methodological details.

text.zh: 中央社報導，研華台灣華亞園區規劃投資約 56 億元，預計於 2028 年第一季前完工；日本北九州投資約 55 億日圓，昆山則規劃第六期擴建。TVBS 報導第三季營收 324.4 億元、歸母淨利 62.18 億元，該季財報在 10 月 29 日已公告，今天新增的是法說中的訂單及工程進度說明。
text.en: CNA cited roughly NT$5.6 billion planned for Taiwan's Huaya site, targeted before Q1 2028, plus an approximately JPY5.5 billion Kitakyushu project and a sixth Kunshan phase. TVBS restated Q3 sales of NT$32.44 billion and profit of NT$6.218 billion; those results were released October 29, while the November 4 news concerns backlog and expansion commentary.

text.zh: 在手訂單的取消及延期細項、各擴建工程已實現的產能，以及最終客戶驗收日未公布。
text.en: Backlog cancellation and deferral breakdowns, realized capacity additions and customer-acceptance dates were not disclosed.

title.zh: 志聖決議換股增持視動至 75.06%，整合先進封裝設備控制軟體
title.en: C Sun approves share swap raising VMotion stake to 75.06%

summary.zh: 志聖工業 11 月 4 日公布董事會決議，擬以新股換股增持視動自動化科技，完成後持股將由 20.7% 增至 75.06%，換股基準日暫訂 2027 年 1 月 4 日。視動的設備控制與通訊軟體將結合志聖等製程設備，交易仍待執行。
summary.en: Taiwan equipment maker C Sun announced a board-approved stock swap on November 4 to raise its VMotion Automation Technology stake from 20.7% to 75.06%. The tentative exchange date is January 4, 2027; VMotion's control and equipment-communications software would be integrated with process-tool development after completion.

text.zh: 視動提供 PC 與 PLC 控制、運動控制、人機介面、資料擷取及 SECS/GEM 通訊模組，對應晶圓廠、封測廠的設備及工廠管理系統。志聖同時提及 G2C+ 聯盟與均豪、均華及東捷的跨設備開發需求。
text.en: VMotion provides PC and PLC controls, motion control, HMIs, data collection and SECS/GEM interfaces for fab and packaging/test tools. C Sun cited equipment-software integration needs across the G2C+ alliance with other equipment makers The proposed collaboration does not establish immediate customer qualification.

text.zh: 中央社引述志聖重訊，每 1 股視動股份擬換發 0.40665 股志聖新發行普通股。視動將在交易完成後成為合併報表子公司；公告未提供已完成交割的證據。
text.en: CNA reported a ratio of 0.40665 newly issued C Sun shares for each VMotion share. VMotion would become a consolidated subsidiary only once the exchange is completed; closing has not been reported.

text.zh: 交易最終完成日、整合軟體於各設備的商用驗證，以及對客戶交期的影響尚未公布。
text.en: The actual closing date, production qualification of integrated software and any effect on delivery schedules remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 英業達公布 10 月營收 799.66 億元、年增 46%，伺服器與筆電均受缺料影響
title.en: Inventec reports NT$79.966B October revenue, up 46% year on year

summary.zh: 英業達 11 月 4 日公布 2026 年 10 月合併營收約 799.66 億元，年增約 46%，累計前 10 個月營收 8,222.28 億元、年增 43.1%。公司表示，第四季伺服器與消費性產品出貨受到缺料影響，細部展望待 11 月 10 日法說揭露。
summary.en: Inventec reported October 2026 consolidated revenue of approximately NT$79.966 billion on November 4, up 46% year on year, and January–October revenue of NT$822.228 billion, up 43.1%. It cited component shortages affecting both servers and consumer products and said further guidance would come at its November 10 investor meeting.

text.zh: 英業達承接伺服器整機與筆記型電腦 ODM 製造。月營收涵蓋多產品業務，不能依整體成長率推導單一 AI 伺服器產品的出貨增幅。
text.en: Inventec is an ODM for server systems and notebooks. Consolidated monthly revenue covers multiple product lines and cannot be used to derive shipments or revenue growth for individual AI-server configurations.

text.zh: 中央社報導，英業達 10 月筆電出貨約 140 萬台，比 9 月少 40 萬台；營收月減約 18.9%，年增約 46%。每月營收與前 10 月累計數字的期間不同，須分開比較。
text.en: CNA reported about 1.4 million notebook shipments in October, down 400,000 units month on month. Revenue declined about 18.9% sequentially but grew about 46% from a year earlier; the October and 10-month cumulative periods are distinct.

text.zh: 伺服器業務單獨營收、缺料零組件項目、延後交貨規模及第四季精確出貨預估尚未揭露。
text.en: Standalone server revenue, components in shortage, delayed-shipment volumes and precise Q4 delivery expectations have not been disclosed.

title.zh: 金居公告增資馬來西亞子公司 500 萬美元，原董事會決議日期為 10 月 16 日
title.en: COTECH discloses US$5M Malaysia subsidiary capital injection

summary.zh: 銅箔廠金居於 11 月 4 日公告對馬來西亞檳城子公司 COTECH Development 增資 500 萬美元，資金將依實際需求分次投入。董事會已於 10 月 16 日通過，這次新消息是正式對外公告；更早公布的檳城高階銅箔廠產能計畫不可視為今天核定。
summary.en: Copper-foil producer COTECH disclosed a US$5 million capital increase for its Penang subsidiary on November 4, with funding to be injected in tranches. The board had approved it on October 16; earlier Penang copper-foil capacity plans are background, not newly approved capacity.

text.zh: 銅箔用於 PCB、載板與高頻高速訊號傳輸結構；金居先前已提出高階 HVLP4 產品與馬來西亞檳城新廠規劃。此筆增資尚無個別設備訂單或產能驗收資料。
text.en: Copper foil supplies PCB and substrate stacks for high-frequency transmission. COTECH previously described HVLP4 foil plans for Penang, but this capital increase does not itself establish equipment orders or accepted production capacity.

text.zh: 中央社引述公司公告，金居持有檳城子公司 100% 股權，增資用途為長期股權投資及海外據點；分次注資代表已核定最高額度，實際撥款節奏待確定。
text.en: CNA cites a 100%-owned Penang subsidiary, with proceeds intended for long-term investment and an overseas site. The maximum announced equity injection may be disbursed in stages, and actual drawdown timing is unspecified.

text.zh: 分次注資日期、新廠實際設備採購與驗收進度，以及產能啟用日期未公告。
text.en: Disbursement dates, plant equipment procurement, acceptance and production start dates are undisclosed.

title.zh: 湧德董事會決議對越南子公司增資 1,000 萬美元，資金擬由銀行借款支應
title.en: UDE approves US$10M capital increase for Vietnam subsidiary

summary.zh: 台灣網路連接器廠湧德電子 11 月 4 日公告，董事會決議對 100% 持股越南子公司 U.D. Electronic Vietnam 現金增資 1,000 萬美元，資金來源擬為銀行借款。公告將用途列為長期投資，未明列新增機台、產能或產線啟用日期。
summary.en: Taiwan connector maker UDE announced a board-approved US$10 million cash injection into its wholly owned Vietnam subsidiary on November 4, to be funded through bank borrowing. It described the purpose as long-term investment without identifying new tools, rated output or commissioning dates.

text.zh: 湧德供應整合型乙太網路連接器及相關網路零組件，產品可進入網通設備供應鏈。對越南子公司注資與連接器交貨量、良率是不同指標。
text.en: UDE supplies integrated Ethernet connectors and networking components. Funding a Vietnamese subsidiary is distinct from connector shipments, yields or customer acceptance.

text.zh: 中央社引述公司資料，湧德 10 月營收 7.34 億元，年增 63.67%；前 10 月營收 73.32 億元，年增 47.09%。這些屬已公布的營收實績，資本額仍是董事會決議的資金配置。
text.en: CNA also cited October revenue of NT$734 million, up 63.67% year on year, and 10-month revenue of NT$7.332 billion, up 47.09%. These are reported sales results, separate from the approved capital allocation.

text.zh: 越南廠新增設備、實際注資日、資金提款及客戶認證進度尚未披露。
text.en: New Vietnam tooling, funding and drawdown dates, and customer qualifications remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 台郡法說稱 PTFE 高頻材料擬於 2028 年放量，第三季仍虧損 1.79 億元
title.en: Taiflex targets 2028 PTFE ramp; reports NT$179M Q3 loss

summary.zh: 台郡科技 11 月 4 日法說表示，高頻高速 PTFE 材料規劃於 2028 年開始放量；2026 年第三季營收 61.4 億元、歸母淨損 1.79 億元、毛利率 10.8%。量產時間是公司預期，尚無獨立核實的客戶驗收或產量。
summary.en: Taiflex stated at its November 4 investor briefing that it targets volume production of high-frequency PTFE materials in 2028. Q3 revenue was NT$6.14 billion, with a NT$179 million attributable loss and 10.8% gross margin; customer qualifications and output for the proposed ramp remain undisclosed.

text.zh: PTFE 具有低介電損耗特性，應用涵蓋高頻通訊、雷達與高速傳輸材料。公司將其列為高階材料新產品方向；與現有柔性電路板實際出貨須分別看待。
text.en: PTFE's low dielectric loss supports high-frequency links, radar and high-speed electronics. Taiflex is developing it as a higher-end materials line, separate from existing flexible-circuit-board shipments.

text.zh: 中央社引述公司，第三季營業利益率為負 4.3%，每股虧損 0.56 元；公司估計 2027 年消費性產品營收占比可能降至 50% 以下。這些未來產品組合預估不代表已取得量產訂單。
text.en: CNA reported a negative 4.3% Q3 operating margin and a loss of NT$0.56 per share. Taiflex projected consumer products could fall below half of revenue in 2027, but this is an outlook, not evidence of contracted PTFE volume.

text.zh: PTFE 材料客戶驗證、規格、良率、工程階段與實際開始出貨日期未提供。
text.en: PTFE customer qualification, specifications, yields, engineering milestones and shipment launch date have not been disclosed.

title.zh: 新代 11 月 4 日更新馬來西亞二廠進度，規劃整體產能達現況 2.6 倍
title.en: Syntec updates Malaysia second-plant timing and 2.6x capacity target

summary.zh: 工業控制器廠新代科技 11 月 4 日表示，馬來西亞第二廠、中國蘇州第二廠及另一海外據點預計自 2027 年 2 月起陸續完工與搬遷，整體產能規劃提高至目前約 2.6 倍。馬來西亞建廠安排先前已有報導，這次新增的是公司對多廠進度與總產能的更新。
summary.en: Industrial controller supplier Syntec said on November 4 that its second Malaysia factory, second Suzhou facility and another overseas site should begin staged completion or relocation from February 2027. Its combined capacity target is 2.6 times the current level; the Malaysia plant had been discussed earlier, while the new disclosure updates the group-wide plan.

text.zh: 新代供應 CNC、運動控制、伺服元件與機械手臂控制技術，應用於工廠自動化與精密加工。此次產能倍率為集團多據點規劃，並非馬來西亞單廠已完成擴產。
text.en: Syntec supplies CNC, motion control, servo components and robotic controls for industrial automation. The capacity multiplier is group-wide and does not mean the Malaysia factory alone has achieved higher output.

text.zh: 中央社報導，企業將感測、製程資料與控制器整合至現場加工應用。公司原在 2026 年 5 月已預告馬來西亞廠目標於 2027 年 2 月完工，11 月 4 日的說明增加整體 2.6 倍產能規劃；報導亦提及印度據點，但不將其列入本站東南亞市場範圍。
text.en: CNA described integrating sensing, shop-floor data and CNC applications. The February 2027 Malaysia target had already been disclosed in May; the November 4 update adds a 2.6x group-wide capacity goal. An India site is mentioned in the source but is outside this edition's geographic focus.

text.zh: 各地新廠實際產線數、馬來西亞單廠增幅、客戶需求量及具體完工日仍未公開。
text.en: Plant-level line counts, the Malaysia-only capacity increase, customer volume and exact completion dates remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 聯發科宣布 11 月 9 日延攬前英特爾主管，負責先進製程與封裝協同
title.en: MediaTek appoints former Intel executive for advanced process and packaging coordination

summary.zh: 聯發科 11 月 4 日宣布，前英特爾主管 Navid Shahriari 預定 11 月 9 日加入，擔任資深副總經理，負責先進製程、良率平台、設計協同優化、先進測試封裝及品質可靠度團隊。公司表示將深化與台積電等供應鏈夥伴的合作，未公布新產能或新訂單。
summary.en: MediaTek announced November 4 that former Intel executive Navid Shahriari will join on November 9 as senior vice president overseeing advanced process and yield platforms, design-technology optimization, advanced test and packaging, and quality/reliability. MediaTek cited closer work with suppliers including TSMC, but announced no new capacity or orders.

text.zh: IC 設計公司與晶圓代工、封裝測試夥伴之間的設計技術協同，涉及元件良率、測試流程及產品可靠度驗證。人事任命沒有直接量化個別製程的成熟度或客戶驗證進展。
text.en: Design-technology co-optimization across fabless design, foundry and packaging/test touches yield, test and reliability flows. The appointment provides no direct measure of manufacturing maturity or customer acceptance.

text.zh: 中央社引述聯發科公告，Shahriari 擁有 37 年相關工程經驗，將向總經理暨營運長陳冠州報告。聯發科先前提出的資料中心 ASIC 營收與市占預測屬舊資料，此次報導以人事與供應鏈職責變動為主。
text.en: CNA reported Shahriari has 37 years of relevant engineering experience and will report to president and COO Joe Chen. Previously announced data-center ASIC forecasts are background; this development is the leadership and supplier-coordination appointment.

text.zh: 供應鏈合作協議是否有變更、量產良率改進幅度與新產品時程未披露。
text.en: Changes to supply agreements, yield improvements and new-product schedules were not disclosed.

title.zh: 合勤控 11 月 3 日法說確認越南網通廠試產，預期 2027 年放量
title.en: Zyxel Group confirms Vietnam production trial and targets 2027 ramp

summary.zh: 合勤控 11 月 3 日在線上法說表示，越南生產基地於 2026 年進入試產，預計 2027 年放量，並規劃推出 Wi-Fi 8 與 50G PON 網通設備。第三季歸母淨利為 4.69 億元；公司稱記憶體成本上升，使部分電信客戶放緩拉貨。
summary.en: Taiwan networking company Zyxel Group said at its November 3 investor call that its Vietnam plant is in trial production and is expected to ramp in 2027, alongside planned Wi-Fi 8 and 50G PON products. It reported Q3 net profit of NT$469 million and cited memory costs behind slower orders from some telecom customers.

text.zh: 合勤控生產寬頻接取與企業網通設備，越南基地被公司列為新增製造據點，與現有無錫產能並行。新產品的開發完成、客戶下單及正式量產是不同階段。
text.en: Zyxel Group supplies broadband access and enterprise networking systems. The Vietnam facility complements existing Wuxi manufacturing. Product development, customer orders and volume qualification are separate stages.

text.zh: 中央社報導前 3 季歸母淨利 10.99 億元，寬頻設備營收占比 76%、企業網通占比 14%。自由財經報導第三季營收 77.53 億元，季減 11.4%、年減 20.8%。上述數字不代表越南新廠單獨營收。
text.en: CNA reported nine-month attributable profit of NT$1.099 billion and revenue shares of 76% broadband and 14% enterprise networking. Liberty Times reported Q3 revenue of NT$7.753 billion, down 11.4% quarter on quarter and 20.8% year on year. None measures the Vietnam plant on a standalone basis.

text.zh: 越南基地設計產能、良率、客戶驗收及正式量產月份未公布。
text.en: Vietnam nameplate capacity, yields, qualifications and exact volume-production start month were not disclosed.

title.zh: 數發部訪查嘉義嘉太變電所基地台，確認今年 6 月完工的供電與通訊備援配置
title.en: Taiwan ministry inspects resilient base station at Chiayi substation

summary.zh: 台灣數位發展部 11 月 3 日赴嘉義縣太保市嘉太變電所，訪查與台電變電所整合的高抗災基地台。官方指出設施早在 2026 年 6 月完工，具備電力、雷射光傳輸第二路由及抗 15 級風結構；新事件是此次訪查與配置揭露，不能當作 11 月新建完工。
summary.en: Taiwan's Ministry of Digital Affairs inspected a resilient mobile base station at the Jiatai power substation in Taibao, Chiayi County on November 3. The ministry says the site was completed in June 2026 and combines substation power, a second laser-based backhaul and wind resistance to Beaufort force 15; the November event was an inspection and technical disclosure, not new construction completion.

text.zh: 基地台的斷電、後傳光纜中斷及耐風是不同失效模式。數發部表示三家電信商各自設置雷射光傳輸設備作為第二條路由，並利用變電所供電降低斷電風險。
text.en: Power loss, backhaul interruption and wind damage are distinct mobile-network failure modes. The ministry says three telecom providers installed laser-based second backhaul paths, while substation integration improves access to power.

text.zh: 官方公告回顧 2023 至 2025 年補助建置或優化 93 處高抗災基地台、55 輛行動基地台車等既有成果。93 處等數字屬先前完成計畫的累計量，不是 11 月 3 日新增完工量。
text.en: The ministry separately cited cumulative 2023–25 work on 93 resilient base stations and 55 mobile base-station vehicles. These are historical cumulative program figures, not additional November 3 completions.

text.zh: 此次示範站的實測備援持續時間、分業者投資成本與後續擴建據點尚未公布。
text.en: Measured backup runtime at this site, provider-specific costs and additional rollout sites were not specified.

text.zh: 研華公布的是接單量與期限資訊，尚須經出貨、驗收與會計認列；報導未提供取消及延期訂單的完整拆分。
text.en: Advantech's reported backlog extends into future periods and awaits delivery, acceptance and accounting recognition; the detailed cancellation and deferral split is unavailable.

text.en: The figure is a proposed post-transaction stake. The November 4 release was a board decision, with a tentative January 4, 2027 exchange date.

question.zh: 馬來西亞 500 萬美元與檳城新廠總投資相同嗎？
question.en: Is the US$5M injection the total Penang plant budget?

text.zh: 500 萬美元為本次對子公司的增資額，與先前公布的檳城新廠總投資規劃分屬不同範圍，尚待實際注資。
text.en: US$5M is this subsidiary equity injection, distinct from previously described total Penang factory spending; actual staged payments remain to be made.

title.zh: 11 月 4 日已報導的機房投資

text.zh: Google 馬來西亞投資計畫、印尼 LG CNS 與 NTT DATA 資料中心進度已收錄 11 月 4 日日報；這些事件在本版僅作前期背景，並未重複當作新消息。
text.en: Google's Malaysian data-center plans and the LG CNS and NTT DATA facility reports were covered in the November 4 edition and are retained only as dated context.

text.zh: 11 月 4 日科技股波動及美國選舉影響的市場評論以價格與推測為主，缺乏本期新增的產能、出貨或已核定政策證據，因此未列入新聞。
text.en: November 4 price movements and election-driven market commentary lacked new verified capacity, shipments or enacted policy measures and were excluded.

verificationNote.zh: 研華、志聖、英業達、金居、湧德與台郡的部分數字以中央社等媒體引述企業公告或法說為依據；研華官網可確認法說日期，但無法直接取得本次數字的官方逐字稿。金居 500 萬美元增資於 11 月 4 日公告，董事會決議日期為 10 月 16 日。未完成的交易、在手訂單、產能與量產目標均按各自狀態呈現。
verificationNote.en: Several figures for Advantech, C Sun, Inventec, COTECH, UDE and Taiflex rely on CNA or other reporting of company statements. Advantech's investor-relations page confirms the briefing date, but an official transcript for the numerical claims was unavailable. COTECH's US$5M injection was disclosed November 4 after an October 16 board decision. Pending transactions, backlog and capacity targets are identified by status.
